arc.fallback: The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop

description.fallback: Iggy stares at the Stand-using falcon, Pet Shop, realizing he has stumbled upon the hideout of DIO. Pet Shop lands close to Iggy, analyzing whether or not the dog is of any threat to its master. Being forced into this journey, Iggy has no care for stopping DIO and therefore has no intention of dying fighting this bird.

outro.fallback: Pet Shop tries to attack the kid, but Iggy tackles the bird mid-flight.
